subject: ACE co-sell: PDM/PSM matchmaking + contract value confirmation
messages:
From: Lena Torres <lena.torres@medfast.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com
Cc: devops@medfast.com
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — MedFast readiness

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the demo last week — we walked through the latency & cost numbers with our architecture leads and theres clear interest in moving forward with a pilot. Were targeting a Q1 integration with a production pilot later in Q2.

Two asks to unblock ACE registration on our side:
- Can you confirm a point estimate for expected monthly committed spend for a 6-node inference pool (approx. 3M tokens/day) — we need this to justify the AWS co-sell intake.
- Please introduce the appropriate PDM/PSM who will own the technical validation and co-sell paperwork (well need a short joint-call).

Im attaching our security questionnaire and the signed NDA (PDF stubs).

Files attached: medfast_security_questionnaire_v2.pdf, MedFast_NDA_signed.pdf

Thanks,
Lena Torres
Director, Cloud Platform
MedFast Health

--
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: Lena Torres <lena.torres@medfast.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — MedFast readiness

Hi Lena — great to hear and thanks for sending over the questionnaire + NDA.

Short answers up front:
- Estimate: ballpark committed spend for the pilot you described (6-node pool, 3M tokens/day) is around $40k–$55k/month depending on quantization and batch sizing; I will ask Sales Ops to produce a more precise run-rate by EOD.
- PDM/PSM: looping in Kimberly (seller lead) and Tessa (PDM) here — Kimberly will coordinate the commercial paperwork and PDM can validate the integration/ops plan.

Suggested next steps:
1) Quick 30-min sync with your infra lead + Tessa next week to walk validation criteria and KV/prefix caching expectations.
2) Well run an internal costing calc and post it to the HubSpot opportunity record (Ill share the link).
3) Simultaneously start the ACE registration — Kimberly can confirm the partner enrollment checklist items.

Kimberly/Tessa — could you confirm availability for a 30-min call Tue/Wed next week and whether well need any artifact beyond the attached security questionnaire?

Best,
Rishi
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: MedFast ACE — action items before PDM/PSM sync

Kimberly / Tessa,

Summary of external ask (from Lena):
- Estimate committed monthly spend for ACE intake (pilot: 6-node pool, 3M tokens/day).
- PDM intro for a short technical validation call.
- They attached security questionnaire + signed NDA (attached to thread).

My thoughts:
- Sales Ops calc: Ill get Ops to model a low/medium/high run-rate with/without INT8 quantized model selection. Target to have by EOD tomorrow.
- Tessa: please prepare a short checklist for the validation call: required telemetry, network egress expectations, data residency notes, and recommended fallback model variant for degraded capacity. Keep it to a one-pager.
- Kimberly: confirm who in Partner Ops will submit the ACE intake and whether we need an SOW pre-ACE for legal. If we can get preliminary committed spend, AWS marketplace intake often requires a committed value figure.

Also: add HubSpot opp id hs_opp_883225 and mark as ACE-intake in the record.

Thanks — Rishi
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Internal: MedFast ACE — action items before PDM/PSM sync

Thanks Rishi — quick notes:
- I can confirm Partner Ops can file the ACE intake once we have a committed value estimate. For ACE & co-sell prioritization AWS typically prefers >$30k/mo committed ARR for a standard co-sell push; >$75k/month gets higher priority in APJ/US tooling.
- For SOW: legal prefers an outline (SOW-lite) for pilots over 3 months. We dont need a fully executed SOW to register, but having a headline committed value and pilot scope is helpful.
- Im available Wed 10am or Thu 2pm PT for a quick triage call.

Tessa — can you draft a one-pager validation checklist? If you want, I can pull in Partner Ops (Alejandro) after we have the committed value.

Kimberly Park
Senior Seller, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
From: Lena Torres <lena.torres@medfast.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.inference.com, tessa_morgan@redwood.inference.com, devops@medfast.com
Date: Thu, 9 Dec 2027 15:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ACE registration & PDM/PSM intro — MedFast readiness

Thanks everyone — quick updates from our side: 
- Committed value: preliminary internal approval for a $48k/month committed pilot (3 months) — finance will confirm next week but this should satisfy ACE intake.
- Attached: signed NDA (MedFast_NDA_signed.pdf) and the completed security questionnaire (medfast_security_questionnaire_v2.pdf).
- Availability: Wed 15 Dec 11am PT works for our infra lead (DevOps) and me for the validation call.

We look forward to the checklist from Tessa and the costing calc from Rishi. If Partner Ops (Alejandro) needs any additional paperwork, please tell us what fields to expect in the ACE form.

Best,
Lena
Director, Cloud Platform | MedFast Health
